settings.title: MyoLift App Membership
settings.content: The difference between the MyoLift QT+ Base and Premium memberships is reflected in the MyoLift Smart App experience. With the Base Membership, you receive a 30-day free trial to all Premium app features. After the trial ends, the Base Membership provides access to App-Free Mode and My QT Plan only. Most treatment options within the “Sessions”menu will be locked, as these are part of the Premium features. The Premium Membership unlocks full access to all guided treatments, advanced sessions, and app features designed to maximize your MyoLift results

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Step 1: Clarify – Cleanse the skin with the Mangosteen Cleanser to remove buildup and prep the skin.
Step 2: Hydrate – Mist generously with RePlenish Spritzer to balance and prime the skin.
Step 3: Treat – Perform your microcurrent session using one of the methods below:

  • Sheet Mask: Days 1, 8, 14
  • QT Probes: Days 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13
  • Hands-Free Masks: Days 3, 5, 10, 12

Note: Steps 1 & 2 remain the same each day. Step 3 alternates based on your treatment day to maximize hydration and firming.

settings.content:

settings.heading: Why You'll Love It
settings.section_content: The Moisture Boost Skincare Kit is specially formulated to deeply hydrate and restore your skin’s natural barrier using clinically proven ingredients like Hyaluronic Acid, Chamomile, and Epidermal Growth Factor. Designed to work seamlessly with the MyoLift microcurrent device, this kit enhances moisture retention, reduces redness, and leaves your skin feeling plump and revitalized. It’s ideal for those looking to strengthen their skin’s defenses against environmental stressors while achieving a radiant, nourished complexion.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What is the main goal of this kit?
settings.text1: It’s designed to strengthen the skin barrier and deeply hydrate, resulting in plumper, soothed, and more resilient skin.
settings.title2: Can I use the kit daily, Is this beginner-friendly?
settings.text2:
Yes. The hydrating mist, gel, and cleanser are daily-use-friendly, while the treatment tools follow a 14-day alternating schedule for best results.

The 3-step protocol is simple to follow, and the included products are gentle and effective for all experience levels.
settings.title3: Is this kit suitable for dry or irritated skin?
settings.text3: Definitely. With hyaluronic acid, chamomile, and EGF, it's perfect for calming redness and restoring moisture.
settings.title4: Can I travel with this kit?
settings.text4: Yes. Most items are under travel size limits, and the compact packaging makes it easy to carry your essentials.
settings.title5: How does this differ from the Firm & Brightening Kit?
settings.text5: The Moisture Boost Kit focuses on hydration and barrier repair, while the Firm & Brightening Kit targets elasticity and tone.
